verdict.rationale: Pipedrive publishes an official API client for NodeJS under its own GitHub org. Its getting-started docs point to create-pipedrive-app, which scaffolds an app with the Pipedrive API client already wired up, and OpenAPI 3 specs for v1 and v2 can be imported into other tools. missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs beyond NodeJS (e.g., Python, PHP), SDK reference docs or versioning details, and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: scaffold a complete app with OAuth, a database, and the Pipedrive API client already wired up, see create-pipedrive-app
you can always import our OpenAPI 3 specification files (available for both v1 and v2 APIs) into your tool of choice
